No. 55/1/1/85-Cab.
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA (BHARAT SARKAR)
CABINET SECRETARIAT (MANTRIMANDAL SACHIVALAYA)

#/texts/8.label: paragraph
#/texts/8.full_gt_text:
The undersigned is directed to say that the
Council of Ministers as shown in Annexure 'A' have relinquished
their respective offices with effect from the 31st December,
1984.

#/texts/9.label: paragraph
#/texts/9.full_gt_text:
2. Shri Rajiv Gandhi has been sworn-in as the Prime
Minister by the President at 5-15 P.M. today, 31st December,
1984, in the Rashtrapati Bhavan. Other Ministers sworn-in
by the President at 5-15 P.M. today, the 31st December, 1984
are shown at Annexure 'B'.

#/texts/10.label: paragraph
#/texts/10.full_gt_text:
3. Ministry of Home Affairs may kindly take such
action as may be considered necessary regarding issue of
Gazette Notification, etc.

#/texts/13.label: paragraph
#/texts/13.full_gt_text:
Ministry of Home Affairs,
(Shri S. Narayana swamy - Additional Secretary)

#/texts/14.label: paragraph
#/texts/14.full_gt_text:
Copy forwarded for information to :-
1. Lok Sabha Secretariat
(Shri S.C. Kashyap, Secretary-General)

#/texts/16.label: paragraph

(Shri Sudarshan Agarwal, Secretary-General)
